en: The image is a vintage postcard depicting a winding road leading up to a large building set amidst a rural and wooded landscape. The building appears institutional, possibly a manor, school, or hospital, with several smaller outbuildings nearby. The scene is calm, with lush greenery and some cultivated areas. The words 'Birkenruh' and 'Gruss aus Wenden' are printed in red at the top of the card.
